# O’Reilly Media - Technology and Business Training

> O’Reilly, the premier learning platform for technology professionals, offers the industry’s most extensive catalog of high-quality technical and professional skills development courses. From AI, programming, and cloud technologies to essential business skills such as leadership training and critical thinking, O’Reilly delivers highly trusted content from its network of renowned experts that meets a diverse array of learning needs, with more than 59,000 books, over 5,000 role-based on-demand courses, nearly 200 live events each month, access to interactive sandboxes and labs, and more. 

## Enterprise Solutions
- [For Enterprise](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/teams.html): Tailored solutions for organizations to enhance team skills and drive business success.
- [For Government](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/government.html): Specialized training resources designed for government agencies to improve workforce capabilities.
- [For Higher Ed](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/academic.html): Educational resources aimed at institutions of higher learning to support student and faculty development.
- [For Individuals](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/individuals.html): Learning opportunities for individuals seeking to enhance their skills and knowledge.

## Content Marketing and Sponsorship
- [Content Marketing Solutions](https://www.oreilly.com/content-marketing-solutions.html): Lead generation and thought leadership programs for technology companies seeking to reach O’Reilly's 2.8 million users worldwide.
- [Sponsored Content](https://www.oreilly.com/content-marketing/available-products.html): Gate an O’Reilly book, report, or early release title for lead gen campaigns.


## Cloud Technologies
- [Microsoft Azure](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/microsoft-azure/): Comprehensive resources and training for utilizing Microsoft Azure cloud services.
- [Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/amazon-web-services-aws/): In-depth training materials for leveraging AWS cloud solutions.
- [Google Cloud](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/google-cloud/): Resources focused on Google Cloud services and their applications.
- [Cloud Migration](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/cloud-migration/): Guidance on migrating to cloud platforms effectively.
- [Cloud Deployment](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/cloud-deployment/): Best practices for deploying applications in cloud environments.
- [Cloud Platforms](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/cloud-platforms/): Overview of various cloud platforms and their features.

## Data Management
- [Data Warehouse](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/data-warehouse/): Insights into data warehousing concepts and implementations.
- [SQL](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/sql/): Training on SQL for database management and querying.
- [Apache Spark](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/apache-spark/): Resources for using Apache Spark for big data processing.
- [Microsoft SQL Server](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/microsoft-sql-server/): Comprehensive training on Microsoft SQL Server functionalities.
- [MySQL](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/mysql/): Learning materials for MySQL database management.
- [Kafka](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/kafka/): Resources for implementing Kafka for real-time data streaming.
- [Data Lake](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/data-lake/): Understanding data lakes and their role in data management.
- [Streaming & Messaging](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/streaming-messaging/): Insights into streaming data and messaging systems.
- [NoSQL Databases](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/nosql-databases/): Overview of NoSQL databases and their applications.
- [Relational Databases](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/relational-databases/): Training on relational database concepts and management.

## Data Science and Analytics
- [Pandas](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/pandas/): Resources for using Pandas for data manipulation and analysis.
- [R](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/r/): Training materials for statistical computing and graphics using R.
- [MATLAB](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/matlab/): Learning resources for MATLAB programming and applications.
- [SAS](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/sas/): Insights into using SAS for advanced analytics.
- [D3](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/d3/): Training on D3.js for data visualization.
- [Power BI](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/power-bi/): Resources for using Power BI for business intelligence.
- [Tableau](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/tableau/): Comprehensive training on Tableau for data visualization.
- [Statistics](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/statistics/): Fundamental concepts and applications of statistics.
- [Exploratory Data Analysis](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/exploratory-data-analysis/): Techniques for exploring and analyzing data sets.
- [Data Visualization](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/data-visualization/): Best practices for visualizing data effectively.

## Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
- [Generative AI](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/generative-ai/): Insights into generative AI technologies and applications.
- [Machine Learning](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/machine-learning/): Comprehensive training on machine learning principles and practices.
- [Artificial Intelligence (AI)](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/artificial-intelligence-ai/): Overview of AI technologies and their impact.
- [Deep Learning](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/deep-learning/): Resources for understanding and implementing deep learning techniques.
- [Reinforcement Learning](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/reinforcement-learning/): Training on reinforcement learning methodologies.
- [Natural Language Processing](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/natural-language-processing/): Insights into NLP techniques and applications.
- [TensorFlow](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/tensorflow/): Resources for using TensorFlow for machine learning.
- [Scikit-Learn](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/scikit-learn/): Training on Scikit-Learn for machine learning applications.
- [Hyperparameter Tuning](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/hyperparameter-tuning/): Techniques for optimizing machine learning models.
- [MLOps](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/mlops/): Best practices for operationalizing machine learning models.

## Software Development
- [Java](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/java/): Comprehensive resources for Java programming.
- [JavaScript](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/javascript/): Training materials for JavaScript development.
- [Spring](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/spring/): Insights into using the Spring framework for Java applications.
- [Python](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/python/): Resources for Python programming and applications.
- [Go](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/go/): Training on Go programming language.
- [C#](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/c-sharp/): Comprehensive resources for C# development.
- [C++](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/c-plus-plus/): Insights into C++ programming and applications.
- [C](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/c/): Training materials for C programming.
- [Swift](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/swift/): Resources for Swift programming for iOS development.
- [Rust](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/rust/): Insights into Rust programming language.
- [Functional Programming](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/functional-programming/): Overview of functional programming concepts.

## Software Architecture and Design
- [Object-Oriented](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/object-oriented-architecture/): Principles and practices of object-oriented programming.
- [Distributed Systems](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/distributed-systems/): Insights into designing and implementing distributed systems.
- [Domain-Driven Design](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/domain-driven-design/): Best practices for domain-driven design methodologies.
- [Architectural Patterns](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/architectural-patterns/): Overview of common architectural patterns in software development.

## DevOps and IT Operations
- [Kubernetes](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/kubernetes/): Resources for using Kubernetes for container orchestration.
- [Docker](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/docker/): Training on Docker for containerization.
- [GitHub](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/github/): Insights into using GitHub for version control and collaboration.
- [Terraform](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/terraform/): Resources for infrastructure as code using Terraform.
- [Continuous Delivery](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/continuous-delivery/): Best practices for implementing continuous delivery.
- [Continuous Integration](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/continuous-integration/): Insights into continuous integration methodologies.
- [Database Administration](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/database-administration/): Training on database administration practices.
- [Computer Networking](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/computer-networking/): Overview of computer networking concepts.
- [Operating Systems](https://www.oreilly.com/search/topics/operating-systems/): Resources for understanding operating systems.

## Security
- [Network Security](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/network-security/): Best practices for securing network infrastructures.
- [Application Security](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/application-security/): Insights into securing applications against threats.
- [Incident Response](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/incident-response/): Training on responding to security incidents.
- [Zero Trust Model](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/zero-trust-model/): Overview of the zero trust security model.
- [Disaster Recovery](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/disaster-recovery/): Best practices for disaster recovery planning.
- [Penetration Testing / Ethical Hacking](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/penetration-testing-ethical-hacking/): Resources for ethical hacking and penetration testing.
- [Governance](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/governance/): Insights into governance frameworks for security.
- [Malware](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/malware/): Overview of malware types and prevention strategies.
- [Security Architecture](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/security-architecture/): Best practices for designing secure architectures.
- [Security Engineering](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/security-engineering/): Insights into security engineering principles.
- [Security Certifications](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/security-certifications/): Overview of security certifications available.

## Design and User Experience
- [Web Design](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/web-design/): Resources for effective web design practices.
- [Graphic Design](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/graphic-design/): Insights into graphic design principles.
- [Interaction Design](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/interaction-design/): Training on interaction design methodologies.
- [Film & Video](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/film-video/): Resources for film and video production.
- [User Experience (UX)](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/user-experience-ux/): Best practices for enhancing user experience.
- [Design Process](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/design-process/): Overview of the design process in product development.
- [Design Tools](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/design-tools/): Insights into tools used in design.

## Business and Management
- [Agile](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/agile/): Training on agile methodologies for project management.
- [Project Management](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/project-management/): Resources for effective project management practices.
- [Product Management](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/product-management/): Insights into product management strategies.
- [Marketing](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/marketing/): Overview of marketing principles and practices.
- [Human Resources](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/human-resources/): Resources for managing human resources effectively.
- [Finance](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/finance/): Insights into financial management practices.
- [Team Management](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/team-management/): Best practices for managing teams.
- [Business Strategy](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/business-strategy/): Overview of business strategy development.
- [Digital Transformation](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/digital-transformation/): Insights into digital transformation initiatives.
- [Organizational Leadership](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/organizational-leadership/): Training on leadership principles and practices.

## Professional Development
- [Professional Communication](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/professional-communication/): Resources for improving communication skills.
- [Emotional Intelligence](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/emotional-intelligence/): Insights into emotional intelligence and its applications.
- [Presentation Skills](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/presentation-skills/): Training on effective presentation techniques.
- [Innovation](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/innovation/): Best practices for fostering innovation.
- [Critical Thinking](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/critical-thinking/): Resources for developing critical thinking skills.
- [Public Speaking](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/public-speaking/): Training on public speaking techniques.
- [Collaboration](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/collaboration/): Insights into effective collaboration practices.
- [Personal Productivity](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/personal-productivity/): Best practices for enhancing personal productivity.
- [Confidence / Motivation](https://www.oreilly.com/search/skills/confidence-motivation/): Resources for building confidence and motivation.

## Additional Resources
- [All features](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/features.html): Overview of all features available on the O’Reilly platform.
- [Verifiable skills](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/verifiable-skills.html): Insights into skills verification through the platform.
- [AI Academy](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/ai-academy.html): Resources for learning about artificial intelligence.
- [Courses](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/courses.html): Comprehensive list of available courses on the platform.
- [Certifications](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/feature-certification.html): Overview of certification programs offered.
- [Interactive learning](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/intro-interactive-learning.html): Insights into interactive learning methodologies.
- [Live events](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/live-events.html): Information on live events hosted by O’Reilly.
- [Superstreams](https://www.oreilly.com/products/superstreams.html): Overview of superstreams for in-depth learning.
- [Answers](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/feature-answers.html): Resources for finding answers to common questions.
- [Insights reporting](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/insights-dashboard.html): Tools for reporting insights from learning activities.
- [Radar Blog](https://www.oreilly.com/radar/): Blog featuring insights and trends in technology and business.
- [Buy Courses](https://www.oreilly.com/live/): Information on purchasing courses.
- [Plans](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/pricing.html): Overview of subscription plans available.
- [Sign In](https://www.oreilly.com/member/login/?next=): Portal for signing into the O’Reilly platform.
- [Try Now](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/try-now.html): Option to try the O’Reilly platform for free.
- [O’Reilly Platform](https://www.oreilly.com/member/login/): Overview of the O’Reilly learning platform.

## Company Information
- [About O’Reilly](https://www.oreilly.com/about/): Information about O’Reilly Media and its mission.
- [Teach/Write/Train](https://www.oreilly.com/work-with-us.html): Opportunities for teaching, writing, or training with O’Reilly.
- [Careers](https://www.oreilly.com/careers/): Job opportunities at O’Reilly Media.
- [O’Reilly News](https://www.oreilly.com/press/): Latest news and updates from O’Reilly.
- [Media Coverage](https://www.oreilly.com/press/media-coverage.html): Information on media coverage of O’Reilly.
- [Community Partners](https://www.oreilly.com/partner/signup.csp): Overview of community partnerships.
- [Affiliate Program](https://www.oreilly.com/affiliates/): Information on the affiliate program.
- [Submit an RFP](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/rfp.html): Instructions for submitting a request for proposal.
- [Diversity](https://www.oreilly.com/diversity/): O’Reilly's commitment to diversity and inclusion.
- [Support](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/support/): Resources for customer support.
- [Contact Us](https://www.oreilly.com/about/contact.html): Information on how to contact O’Reilly.
- [Newsletters](https://www.oreilly.com/emails/newsletters/): Subscription options for newsletters.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.oreilly.com/privacy.html): O’Reilly's privacy policy.
- [AI Policy](https://www.oreilly.com/about/oreilly-approach-to-generative-ai.html): Overview of O’Reilly's AI policy.
- [Australia & New Zealand](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/anz.html): Information specific to Australia and New Zealand.
- [Japan](https://www.oreilly.co.jp/index.shtml): Information specific to Japan.

## Legal and Compliance
- [Do not sell or share my personal information](https://www.oreilly.com/privacy.html?donotsell=show): Policy regarding personal information.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.oreilly.com/terms/): Terms governing the use of O’Reilly services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.oreilly.com/privacy): Detailed privacy policy of O’Reilly Media.
- [Editorial Independence](link_172]: Information on editorial independence.
- [Modern Slavery Act Statement](https://www.oreilly.com/modern-slavery-act-transparency-statement.html): Compliance statement regarding the Modern Slavery Act.
